notes: No misreadings found. Several items add details the cited guide text does not contain. These look like they come from the package types, which are out of scope here, but a human should confirm them against the types: /configuration/8 (218 px default height), /states/0 (defaultActiveIndex), /configuration/10 (formatY formats y tick labels), /anatomy/0 and /anatomy/3 (showYAxis/showXAxis on by default), and /configuration/0 (the series label is used in the legend and the selected readout). /examples/2 says the guide turns the area off (showArea: false) for the projected tail; the rendered guide text cannot confirm this either way. The last sentence of /examples/1 ('With no activeIndex the plot stays quiet') is slightly loose: interactive defaults to true, so hover or press can still select a point when activeIndex is omitted. It reads as describing the unselected state, not as a guarantee. /facts/gaps/0 matches the evidence; the evidence names the clipped label as 'Jun' in that 320 px test host.
